A '''memory bone chamber''' was a [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Gender/Legends|male's]] sacred place to store the [[Bone/Legends|bones]] of his victims. [[Cradossk/Legends|Cradossk]] had a bone chamber within his private quarters in the [[Bounty Hunters' Guild/Legends|Bounty Hunters' Guild]].<ref name="TMA">''[[The Mandalorian Armor]]''</ref>
